prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, ankle-cut demi statue portrait, five-material body (asymmetric), every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished leg tips at the narrowest point of the lower calf, just above the ankle, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Romanian woman in Balkan glam makeup — warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, long dark-brown hair in glossy voluminous waves, an intense, proud expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a gold coin drop.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest, a cinched waist above a big soft rounded belly and enormous round hips, her left arm crystal, her right arm carved stone, her torso a glass vessel, her leg-stubs vessel and wood.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent orange-red carnelian, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled completely to the brim with clear clear rose-pink water with drifting rose petals, no hollow space, no air gap. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through it, rising to the collarbone line itself.

Left leg (hip to tip): a small sculpted vessel of clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled with clear ice-blue water with drifting snowflakes. At the narrowest point of the lower calf, just above the ankle, her left leg curves inward and seals shut into its own small, smooth, rounded, closed tip — the vessel simply reaching its natural end there. Right leg (hip to tip): carved from ONE solid block of vivid orange-red Osage orange wood, completely opaque, completely opaque. At the narrowest point of the lower calf, just above the ankle, her right leg curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft rose pink on one side and a pale silver on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so pink light glances off one side and silver light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
